supermarket/energy-drink/definition.before: This nonalcoholic beverage is promoted as a way to increase alertness or physical energy for a short time. It usually contains caffeine and sugar, and may also include vitamins, amino acids, or herbal ingredients.
supermarket/energy-drink/definition.after: A drink that usually contains caffeine and is sold to increase alertness.

supermarket/orange-juice/definition.before: This beverage is produced by removing liquid from oranges and is usually served as a drink. It may be sold fresh, pasteurized by gentle heating, or concentrated by removing much of its water.

supermarket/apple-juice/definition.before: A drink produced by pressing or crushing apples to release their liquid. It may be clear or cloudy and can contain added sugar or none.

supermarket/dried-fruit/definition.before: Fruit preserved by removing most of its water, often through sun-drying or controlled heating, lasts longer and has a more concentrated taste and nutrient content.
supermarket/dried-fruit/definition.after: Fruit preserved by removing much of its water.

supermarket/coconut-milk/definition.before: This creamy liquid is produced by blending the flesh of mature coconuts with water and straining the result. It can replace dairy milk and is widely used in cooking.
supermarket/coconut-milk/definition.after: A creamy liquid made from coconut flesh and water.

supermarket/soy-sauce/definition.before: This dark, salty liquid is produced by fermenting soybeans, usually with wheat, salt, and water. It is used to add savory flavor and color to food, particularly in East Asian cuisines.
supermarket/soy-sauce/definition.after: A dark, salty sauce made from fermented soybeans.

supermarket/best-before/definition.before: A date indicating the period during which a food is expected to retain its best quality; it is not always the same as a safety expiration date.
supermarket/best-before/definition.after: A date showing when a food is expected to keep its best quality.

grains-dairy/cream-cheese/definition.before: A soft, mild fresh cheese made by combining milk and cream, valued for its smooth texture as a spread and for use in cooking and baking.
grains-dairy/cream-cheese/definition.after: A soft, smooth cheese often spread on bread.

beverages/herbal-tea/definition.before: This beverage is prepared by steeping plant parts, including leaves, flowers, seeds, or roots, in hot water. Unlike ordinary tea, it usually contains no leaves from the Camellia sinensis plant.

beverages/orange-juice/definition.before: This beverage is produced by removing liquid from oranges and is usually served as a drink. It may be sold fresh, pasteurized by gentle heating, or concentrated by removing much of its water.

beverages/apple-juice/definition.before: A drink produced by pressing or crushing apples to release their liquid. It may be clear or cloudy and can contain added sugar or none.

beverages/grape-juice/definition.before: A beverage produced by pressing or otherwise extracting liquid from grapes is usually consumed fresh. It can also serve as a base for fermentation or for blending with other ingredients.

beverages/energy-drink/definition.before: This nonalcoholic beverage is promoted as a way to increase alertness or physical energy for a short time. It usually contains caffeine and sugar, and may also include vitamins, amino acids, or herbal ingredients.
beverages/energy-drink/definition.after: A drink that usually contains caffeine and is sold to increase alertness.

kitchen-utensils/dutch-oven/definition.before: A dutch oven is a sturdy pot, usually cast iron, with a close-fitting lid. It can brown food, cook it slowly in liquid, or bake it over a stove or campfire.
kitchen-utensils/dutch-oven/definition.after: A heavy cooking pot with a tight-fitting lid.

seasonings-condiments/soy-sauce/definiti.before: This dark, salty liquid is produced by fermenting soybeans, usually with wheat, salt, and water. It is used to add savory flavor and color to food, particularly in East Asian cuisines.
seasonings-condiments/soy-sauce/definiti.after: A dark, salty sauce made from fermented soybeans.

seasonings-condiments/barbecue-sauce/def.before: A flavorful sauce, usually made from tomatoes, is used with grilled, smoked, or roasted meat. It may be brushed on during cooking, used as a marinade, or served at the table.
seasonings-condiments/barbecue-sauce/def.after: A sauce used to flavor grilled or roasted food.

seasons-weather/equinox/definition.before: Either of two times of the year when the sun crosses the plane of the earth's equator and day and night are of equal length.
seasons-weather/equinox/definition.after: One of two times each year when day and night are nearly equal in length.

community-center/talent-show/definition.before: A public school or community event gives students a stage to perform skills such as singing, dancing, or magic. The performances entertain an audience and may be judged as a competition.
community-center/talent-show/definition.after: An event where people perform skills such as singing or dancing.

police-station/holding-cell/definition.before: A secure room in a police station, courthouse, jail, or similar facility holds people for a limited time. They may be waiting for questioning, processing, transfer, or a court appearance.
police-station/holding-cell/definition.after: A secure room where people are held temporarily.

police-station/speed-limit/definition.before: The highest speed at which motor vehicles may lawfully travel on a particular road or within a designated area, as set by signs or traffic law.
police-station/speed-limit/definition.after: The highest speed allowed on a road.

first-aid-room/defibrillator/definition.before: An electronic device that administers an electric shock of preset voltage to the heart through the chest wall in an attempt to restore the normal rhythm of the heart during ventricular fibrillation.
first-aid-room/defibrillator/definition.after: A device that gives an electric shock to help restore a normal heart rhythm.

first-aid-room/bee-sting/definition.before: An injury or small-area reaction follows when a bee's stinger pierces the skin. It commonly causes pain, swelling, and redness, but some people develop a strong allergic response.
first-aid-room/bee-sting/definition.after: An injury caused by a bee's stinger.

first-aid-room/fainting/definition.before: A brief loss of consciousness occurs when blood flow to the brain falls, usually because of changes in automatic body control or circulation, and lasts seconds to minutes.

maps-navigation/gps/definition.before: A navigational system involving satellites and computers that can determine the latitude and longitude of a receiver on Earth by computing the time difference for signals from different satellites to reach the receiver.
maps-navigation/gps/definition.after: A satellite-based system used to find a location.

materials/carbon-fiber/definition.before: A lightweight material made from extremely thin carbon strands arranged in a highly ordered structure. It is usually added to plastics and other materials to make composite parts stronger and stiffer.
materials/carbon-fiber/definition.after: A light, strong material made from thin carbon strands.

money-currency/bank-account/definition.before: Money kept with a bank can be accessed through this account by a person or organization. It supports withdrawals and payments, including transfers, checks, and debit-card purchases.
money-currency/bank-account/definition.after: An arrangement with a bank for keeping and using money.

sports-equipment/golf-ball/definition.before: A small, solid ball covered with dimples is struck with a club during golf, with its surface pattern helping it move through the air against less wind resistance.
sports-equipment/golf-ball/definition.after: A small ball with dimples on its surface, used in golf.

sports-center/long-jump/definition.before: An athletics event where a competitor sprints down a runway, takes off from a marked board, and lands in a sandpit. The recorded distance runs from the board to the nearest mark left in the sand.
sports-center/long-jump/definition.after: A sport in which an athlete runs and jumps as far as possible.

beach/water-skiing/definition.before: A water sport in which a person is pulled across the water on skis by a powered boat; it requires trained supervision and safety equipment.
beach/water-skiing/definition.after: A sport in which a boat pulls a person over water on skis.

human-body-head-and-face/outer-ear/defin.before: The visible part of the ear gathers sound and carries it into the middle ear. In people, it mainly includes the auricle, or outer flap, and the ear canal.
human-body-head-and-face/outer-ear/defin.after: The visible outer part of the ear and the ear canal.

human-body-head-and-face/sound-wave/defi.before: A mechanical wave, meaning a moving disturbance that needs matter to travel, carries alternating regions of pressure through a material and can produce hearing in humans and other animals.
human-body-head-and-face/sound-wave/defi.after: A vibration that travels through a material and can be heard.

human-body-head-and-face/sideburns/defin.before: Facial hair that has grown down the side of a man's face in front of the ears (especially when the rest of the beard is shaved off).
human-body-head-and-face/sideburns/defin.after: Hair growing down the sides of the face, in front of the ears.

human-body-upper-body/rib/definition.before: Any of the 12 pairs of curved arches of bone extending from the spine to or toward the sternum in humans (and similar bones in most vertebrates).
human-body-upper-body/rib/definition.after: One of the curved bones around the chest.

human-body-lower-body/hip-joint/definiti.before: A rounded end of the thigh bone fits into a hollow in the pelvis, forming a joint that supports body weight as the leg moves.
human-body-lower-body/hip-joint/definiti.after: The joint connecting the thigh bone to the pelvis.

human-body-lower-body/groin/definition.before: The crease at the junction of the inner part of the thigh with the trunk together with the adjacent region and often including the external genitals.
human-body-lower-body/groin/definition.after: The area where the inner thigh meets the lower body.

human-body-hands-and-feet/little-finger/.before: This is the hand’s shortest digit, commonly called the pinky, on the side near the ulna, or forearm bone. It contributes to the precise grip used to hold small objects.
human-body-hands-and-feet/little-finger/.after: The smallest finger, next to the ring finger.

human-body-hands-and-feet/pumice-stone/d.before: A lightweight volcanic rock with many small cavities forms when lava containing trapped gas cools and hardens quickly. Its rough surface makes it useful for scrubbing, while crushed pumice stone can be added to lightweight concrete.
human-body-hands-and-feet/pumice-stone/d.after: A light, rough volcanic stone used to remove hard skin.

ages-life-stages/minor/definition.before: (of a scale or mode) having half steps between the second and third degrees, and (usually) the fifth and sixth degrees, and the seventh and eighth degrees.
ages-life-stages/minor/definition.after: A person who is below the legal age of adulthood.

everyday-clothing/polo-shirt/definition.before: A knitted shirt with short sleeves has a soft collar and several buttons below the neck. Polo players originally wore this style, which is now common in casual and semi-formal clothing.
everyday-clothing/polo-shirt/definition.after: A shirt with a collar and a short buttoned opening at the neck.

accessories-jewelry/pocket-watch/definit.before: A small portable clock carried in a pocket is often secured by a chain or a small decorative fob and read after its hinged cover is opened.
accessories-jewelry/pocket-watch/definit.after: A small watch carried in a pocket, often attached to a chain.

birthday-party/musical-chairs/definition.before: Players circle a set of chairs while music plays, with one fewer chair than players. When the music stops suddenly, everyone rushes to sit, and the person without a chair is out. One chair is removed before the music starts again, and play continues until a single winner remains.
birthday-party/musical-chairs/definition.after: A game in which players try to sit when music stops, with fewer chairs than players.

indoor-hobbies/audiobook/definition.before: A recorded book or long story lets you listen as someone reads it aloud. It may come as a sound file or on a disc.
indoor-hobbies/audiobook/definition.after: A recording of a book being read aloud.

creative-hobbies/felting/definition.before: Cloth made by pressing wet wool fibers together until they tangle and stick. It is created without weaving threads across and down. This method is called the felting process. The cloth is thick and warm and works well for hats and blankets.
creative-hobbies/felting/definition.after: Making fabric or shapes by pressing and tangling wool fibers together.

shopping-mall/escalator/definition.before: A clause in a contract that provides for an increase or a decrease in wages or prices or benefits etc. depending on certain conditions (as a change in the cost of living index).
shopping-mall/escalator/definition.after: Moving stairs that carry people between floors.

shopping-mall/elevator/definition.before: Lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building.
shopping-mall/elevator/definition.after: A machine that carries people or goods up and down between floors.

shopping-mall/shopper/definition.before: A commercial agent who shops at the competitor's store in order to compare their prices and merchandise with those of the store that employs them.
shopping-mall/shopper/definition.after: A person who visits shops to buy things.

hospital/emt/definition.before: A trained emergency medical technician, or EMT, gives care before a patient reaches a hospital. An EMT can also take the patient there for more help.
hospital/emt/definition.after: A trained worker who gives emergency medical care before a patient reaches hospital.

hospital/defibrillator/definition.before: An electronic device that administers an electric shock of preset voltage to the heart through the chest wall in an attempt to restore the normal rhythm of the heart during ventricular fibrillation.
hospital/defibrillator/definition.after: A device that gives an electric shock to help restore a normal heart rhythm.

hospital/hospital-bed/definition.before: A medical bed used in hospitals and similar care settings can be adjusted in height and position. It is designed to help staff care for patients, monitor their condition, and provide treatment.

hospital/face-shield/definition.before: A clear protective covering worn over the face to help keep droplets or splashes away from the eyes, nose, and mouth in schools, laboratories, and healthcare settings.
hospital/face-shield/definition.after: A clear protective covering worn over the face.

dentist/burnisher/definition.before: A hand tool with polished agate tips (or other gemstone) for rubbing the gold leaf in order to obtain a highly polished surface, used in gilding.
dentist/burnisher/definition.after: A smooth dental tool used to polish and shape fillings.

dentist/reception-desk/definition.before: A staffed area in an office, hotel, institution, or support service where visitors and callers are welcomed, identified, and sent to the right person or service.
dentist/reception-desk/definition.after: A desk where visitors are welcomed and appointments are arranged.

dentist/sealant/definition.before: A kind of sealing material that is used to form a hard coating on a porous surface (as a coat of paint or varnish used to size a surface).

dental-clinic/sealant/definition.before: A kind of sealing material that is used to form a hard coating on a porous surface (as a coat of paint or varnish used to size a surface).
dental-clinic/sealant/definition.after: A protective coating placed on teeth to help prevent decay.

dental-clinic/gum-graft/definition.before: A dental surgical procedure in which tissue is added to an area of the gums, often to cover exposed tooth roots or rebuild gum tissue.
dental-clinic/gum-graft/definition.after: A procedure that adds tissue to an area of the gums.

dental-clinic/elevator/definition.before: Lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building.
dental-clinic/elevator/definition.after: A dental tool used to loosen a tooth or root before removal.

eye-doctor/cataract-surgery/definition.before: A surgeon removes the eye’s cloudy lens, or part of it, and replaces it with an intraocular lens, an artificial lens placed inside the eye.
eye-doctor/cataract-surgery/definition.after: An operation that replaces a cloudy eye lens with an artificial lens.

hair-salon/trimmer/definition.before: Joist that receives the end of a header in floor or roof framing in order to leave an opening for a staircase or chimney etc.
hair-salon/trimmer/definition.after: A small electric tool used to cut and shape hair.

spa/body-wrap/definition.before: A spa treatment in which the body is covered or wrapped with a product such as clay, cream, or fabric for a period of time.
spa/body-wrap/definition.after: A spa treatment in which the body is covered with a product and wrapped.

spa/dermaroller/definition.before: A hand-held cosmetic device covered with many very small needles that roll over the skin; it should be used only with appropriate hygiene and professional guidance.
spa/dermaroller/definition.after: A handheld skin-care device with a roller covered in tiny needles.

spa/essential-oil/definition.before: A concentrated liquid taken from plants contains their easily released scent compounds. It does not mix with water and is usually made by distilling, pressing, or using a solvent.
spa/essential-oil/definition.after: A concentrated scented oil taken from plants.

spa/herbal-tea/definition.before: This beverage is prepared by steeping plant parts, including leaves, flowers, seeds, or roots, in hot water. Unlike ordinary tea, it usually contains no leaves from the Camellia sinensis plant.
spa/herbal-tea/definition.after: A hot drink made by soaking herbs or other plant parts in water.

gym/protein-powder/definition.before: A powdered food or dietary supplement containing concentrated protein; teenagers should not use supplements to chase body ideals and should discuss dietary needs with a parent or qualified health professional.
gym/protein-powder/definition.after: A powdered supplement containing concentrated protein.

gym/reception-desk/definition.before: A staffed area in an office, hotel, institution, or support service where visitors and callers are welcomed, identified, and sent to the right person or service.

subway/escalator/definition.before: A clause in a contract that provides for an increase or a decrease in wages or prices or benefits etc. depending on certain conditions (as a change in the cost of living index).

subway/elevator/definition.before: Lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building.

car-wash/self-service/definition.before: A system or method lets customers complete tasks or get goods and services without ongoing help from staff. Standard steps or technology usually guide the process.

car-wash/wheel/definition.before: A simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines).

hotel/elevator/definition.before: Lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building.
hotel/elevator/definition.after: A machine that carries people or goods up and down between floors.

laundromat/washing-machine/definition.before: An electric appliance that cleans clothes by moving them through water and detergent. It then rinses the clothes and spins them to remove excess water.

dance-studio/leotard/definition.before: A tight-fitting garment of stretchy material that covers the body from the shoulders to the thighs (and may have long sleeves or legs reaching down to the ankles).

dance-studio/hip-hop/definition.before: A cultural movement that grew among Black and Latino Americans in the United States during the late twentieth century, bringing together rap, DJing, breakdancing, graffiti art, distinctive clothing, slang, and shared social views.

dance-studio/folk-dance/definition.before: A traditional dance rooted in a specific ethnic, regional, or national community, passed informally between generations and connected with local customs, music, and social life.

3d-printer-lab/nozzle/definition.before: A projecting spout from which a fluid is discharged.
3d-printer-lab/nozzle/definition.after: The small opening through which a filament printer deposits melted material.
